an4.82:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.82:1.3: Musāvādī hoti, pisuṇāvāco hoti, pharusāvāco hoti, samphappalāpī hoti.
an4.82:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. 2.
an4.82:2.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an4.82:2.3: Musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti.
an4.82:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge
